data.name: Dharmvir
data.long_meaning: One who upholds dharma and protects the people as a king or hero. Dharmvir represents the embodiment of righteousness and strength in Hindu mythology.
data.spiritual_meaning: To uphold righteousness and protect the people as a true leader.

in_sanskrit.name: धर्मवीर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who possesses and protects Dharma (righteousness, moral order)

in_hindi.name: धर्मवीर
in_hindi.long_meaning: वह जीसा धर्म (Dharma) को प्राप्त रखता है और रक्षा करता है (One who possesses and protects Dharma (righteousness, moral order))

in_tamil.name: தர்மவிர
in_tamil.long_meaning: தர்மம் அவர்களின் உடன் உள்ள அல்லவான மனவியர் (One who is a valiant man possessing Dharma (righteousness, moral order))

in_telugu.name: ధర్మవీర
in_telugu.long_meaning: ధర్మము ఆశేశోదేశ్యేశ్వరముయే ఉద్యోగ్యేదరో (One who possesses and protects Dharma (righteousness, moral order) like God)

in_marathi.name: Dharmvir
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dharma (Duty, Morality) + Vir (Hero, King)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmvir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who upholds dharma and protects the people as a king or hero. Dharmvir represents the embodiment of righteousness and strength in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.name: Dharmvir
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Dharma (Duty, Morality) + Vir (Hero, King)
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dharmvir একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who upholds dharma and protects the people as a king or hero. Dharmvir represents the embodiment of righteousness and strength in Hindu mythology.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dharmvir reflects the importance of Dharma in Hindu culture. Dharma refers to the moral laws and duties that individuals are expected to uphold. By giving a person the name Dharmvir, their families and community express the hope and expectation that they will embody the virtues of honesty, truth, and moral responsibility. The name also carries a regal connotation, suggesting that the bearer is a leader and defender, regarded as a model to follow.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dharmvir also holds spiritual significance, as it denotes one who is divinely guided to adhere to spiritual principles. As a protector of the dharma, the holder of this name is considered a spiritual warrior, constantly engaging in conscious action that benefits both themselves and others. Akin to a guardian deity or archetype, Dharmvir encapsulates the strength, wisdom, and righteousness that is inherent in the universe and acting in accordance with it elevates one's soul towards spiritual growth and union with the divine.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Dharmvir is a name mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic. The name Dharmvir carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Dharmvir is a warrior in the Mahabharata who fought on the side of the Pandava brothers.

trends: The name Dharmvir is not commonly used in modern India.
